def components(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:

                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
                res.append((col,cells))
    return res

    """Two colors, two shapes each. Pair shapes by size rank (ties: wider first).
    Left color = color of the shape with the smallest leftmost column.
    Bottom-anchored stack of blocks (smaller total pair on top, 1 blank row
    between), shapes bottom-aligned in each block, left shape at col 0, right
    shape at rcol = max left-color shape width + 1."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # connected components
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] and (i, j) not in seen:
                col, st, cells = grid[i][j], [(i, j)], set()
                while st:
                    a, b = st.pop()
                    if (a, b) in seen:
                        continue
                    seen.add((a, b)); cells.add((a, b))
                    for da, db in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        x, y = a + da, b + db
                        if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] == col and (x, y) not in seen:
                            st.append((x, y))
                comps.append((col, cells))
    bycolor = {}
    for c, cells in comps:
        bycolor.setdefault(c, []).append(cells)
    cols = sorted(bycolor)
    def norm(cells):
        mi = min(i for i, j in cells); mj = min(j for i, j in cells)
        return {(i - mi, j - mj) for i, j in cells}
    HH = lambda s: max(i for i, j in s) + 1
    WW = lambda s: max(j for i, j in s) + 1
    lm = {c: min(j for s in bycolor[c] for _, j in s) for c in cols}
    left = min(cols, key=lambda c: lm[c])
    right = cols[0] if left == cols[1] else cols[1]
    for c in bycolor:
        bycolor[c] = [norm(s) for s in bycolor[c]]
        bycolor[c].sort(key=lambda s: (len(s), -WW(s)))
    rcol = max(WW(s) for s in bycolor[left]) + 1
    pairs = list(zip(bycolor[left], bycolor[right]))
    pairs.sort(key=lambda p: len(p[0]) + len(p[1]))
    heights = [max(HH(a), HH(b)) for a, b in pairs]
    start = h - (sum(heights) + len(pairs) - 1)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    r = start
    for (a, b), hh in zip(pairs, heights):
        for i, j in a:
            out[r + hh - HH(a) + i][j] = left
        for i, j in b:
            out[r + hh - HH(b) + i][rcol + j] = right
        r += hh + 1
    return out
